ITEM 1 | Pale cream-white florets with slightly ivory/yellowish tint, bumpy curd-like surface, clustered into small bite-sized pieces about 1–3 cm across with thin pale stems, arranged on the left side of the red plate covering roughly 20% of its area, matte and dry, firm and holding shape | 110
ITEM 2 | Whole apple, red blush over yellow-green background with some speckling, glossy waxy skin, rounded shape about 7–8 cm in diameter, stem cavity visible at top, sitting at the upper right of the plate covering roughly 12% of its area, firm and unbroken | 165
ITEM 3 | Bright green broccoli florets with dense, tightly packed buds and darker blue-green tops, pale green stems, clusters about 2–5 cm across, matte and slightly moist-looking, firm and holding shape, arranged in the lower right and center of the plate covering roughly 25% of its area | 150
ITEM 4 | Single loose bright green broccoli floret, dense bud top with small stem, about 3–4 cm across, matte, firm, sitting at the upper right beside the apple covering roughly 3% of the plate | 35
